verdict.rationale: Chroma documents dense similarity queries and lists 'Sparse vector search – Lexical search (BM25, SPLADE)' on its homepage. Its full-text $contains/$regex where_document filters can be combined with .query, but they act as filters, not as a scored lexical signal. Nothing in the evidence shows dense and sparse scores fused into one ranked hybrid query. Missing for 10: documented hybrid query combining dense and sparse/BM25 scores, fusion ranking (e.g. RRF or weighted), in-depth docs beyond a homepage feature line, independent hands-on corroboration.
